title: Out of Distribution, Out of Luck: How Well Can LLMs Trained on Vulnerability Datasets Detect Top 25 CWE Weaknesses?
reasoning: The paper is focused on the technical domain of software vulnerability detection using LLMs. It benchmarks models against code weaknesses (CWEs) and analyzes dataset-induced biases, but it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, theology, morals, or ethics.
